kultivator.screen.help.murid.title: Disciples
kultivator.screen.help.murid: Scroll › Disciple › Disciple shows one of your disciples. Right-click a disciple or press the Disciple key to open it; ← → switch between your disciples nearby, Shift + ← → switch the sub. Status holds the realm seal, the cultivation, qi and stored qi bars and the Orders row at the bottom (Follow, Stay, Meditate, Assist, Guard Hall). Techniques teaches arts and fills the combat slots, Pills & Dao feeds pills, starts the breakthrough, swears the Dao and releases the disciple. Powers holds Talents and Treasures, Path holds Stars, Bonds, Heir and Destroyer. When the disciple is more than 64 blocks away every sub but the Diary is locked until you come closer.
